source_snapshot.body:
Pushed the fix from my review as `9c74d47`, since it was the only thing blocking this and it was already written and tested.

**What changed** — only `core-ingestion/src/queries.ts` and `queries.php.test.ts`. Your commit is untouched.

- `property_declaration`, `property_promotion_parameter` and the parameter query now accept `optional_type` alongside `named_type`, so `?Service` resolves.
- The parameter pattern alternates over `[(method_declaration) (function_definition)]`, so top-level functions get typed parameters too.

No handler change was needed, exactly as expected: `childForFieldName('name')` works on `function_definition`, and with no enclosing class the scope falls back to the bare function name — which is what `findEnclosingFunction` already returns for a top-level function.

**Union types stay bare deliberately.** `Service|Repo` has no single receiver type to attribute the call to, so picking one member arbitrarily would be worse than the fallback. I added a test pinning that so it reads as a decision rather than an oversight.

**Verified**
- 3 new tests; the two covering the fixed gaps fail without the query change (`× resolves nullable declared types`, `× resolves typed parameters on plain functions`)
- `queries.php.test.ts` + `resolveEdges.test.ts`: 39 passed (was 36)
- full `ix-cli` suite: 686 passed / 51 files; `npm run typecheck` clean
- `core-ingestion`: 6 failures, the same six you documented as pre-existing on `origin/main` — no new ones

One thing worth flagging for anyone editing this file later: `PHP_QUERIES` is a template literal, so backticks inside those query comments terminate the string. I used them in a first draft and got `Expected ':' but found ';'` from a completely unrelated-looking line. The comments now use plain text.

This clears the blocking review item. The remaining note is the minor one about `.php` joining the prescan set, which is the same incremental-map cost I raised on #375 and is better dealt with there.
